import asyncio

async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Use the searchbox to filter for 'aem-hacker'
    searchbox = page.get_by_role("searchbox", name="Filter by name")
    await searchbox.fill("aem-hacker")
    await searchbox.press("Enter")
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Allow time for search results to update
    
    # Step 2: Find and click the link for the aem-hacker project
    # The project link might be under a heading, so use a more specific selector
    # Look for a link with name containing 'aem-hacker' (case-insensitive)
    project_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="aem-hacker", exact=False)
    await project_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 3: Click on the Issues link to go to the issues page
    issues_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Issues")
    await issues_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 4: Click on the 'New issue' button to create a new issue
    new_issue_button = page.get_by_role("link", name="New issue")
    await new_issue_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 5: Fill in the issue title
    title_field = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Title")
    await title_field.fill("OSError: [Errno 98] Address already in use during executions")
    
    # Step 6: Fill in the issue description
    description_field = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Description")
    await description_field.fill("I am experiencing 'OSError: [Errno 98] Address already in use' during executions in aem-hacker. This error occurs when trying to run processes that bind to a port that is already in use. Please investigate.")
    
    # Step 7: Submit the issue
    submit_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Submit issue")
    await submit_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Wait for confirmation
    
    # No further actions needed; the issue should be created.
